newsitem.title: USA: Lucent awarded $535 mln in contracts.
newsitem.headline: Lucent awarded $535 mln in contracts.

text.p: Lucent Technologies on Thursday said it was awarded telecommunications equipment contracts in Brazil, Hong Kong and Indonesnia worth a total of $535 million.
In Brazil, Lucent will supply wireless equipment to two of the country's largest telephone companies to increase subscriber capacity and improve cellular service quality.
The Brazilian contracts are with Telecomunicacoes do Estado do Parana (Telepar), worth $154 million, and Telecomunicacoes do Estado do Sao Paulo (Telesp), worth $176 million.

In a $105 million agreement with P.T. Komunikasi Selular Indonesia (Komselindo), an Indonesian cellular operator, Lucent will supply digital wireless infrastructure equipment based on the country's first installation of Code Division Multiple Access (CDMA) technology.

In Hong Kong, Lucent will install digital access infrastructure equipment over a five-year period for New T&T, one of the area's fixed-line telecommunications service providers. The contract, announced Thursday in Hong Kong, is valued at $100 million.
